Perit AI (YC F26) is the human data partner frontier AI labs use to train their next generation of models, across audio, egocentric data, RL coding tasks, and enterprise datasets. Every lab is racing to build its own models, and the bottleneck isn't compute anymore. It's high-quality human data. Perit's network of 1,600+ experts in 9+ countries collects, annotates, and quality-checks that data, then delivers it in the exact format each lab trains on. Their marketplace also makes it easy for experts in any field to propose tasks directly to frontier labs. In just 4.5 months, Perit has generated $9M+ in non-annualized revenue at high gross margins and works with multiple frontier labs. Kshitij Dixit is a two-time YC founder and IIT Kharagpur alum who scaled his last company, Zeo, to [...] and IIT Kharagpur alum who scaled his last company, Zeo, to millions of drivers across 100+ countries and millions of dollars in revenue. Poorva Dixit, also a two-time YC founder and IIT Kharagpur alum, led engineering work across big tech, including Google, Uber, Atlassian, and Flipkart. Working separately, they came to the same conclusion: every lab will want its own models, and the data behind them is what's missing. If you're an expert, comment below with the data you have, and Perit may be able to help you pitch it to the labs. If you're a frontier lab, reach out to them at perit.ai.
